description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/bls/cpi (base $0.01; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?series=CUUR0000SA0,CUUR0000SA0L1E&start=2024&end=2026 (up to 10 CPI series ids, up to 20 years). Consumer Price Index series from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API v2: up to 10 CPI series ids (e.g. CUUR0000SA0) with an optional start and end year (up to 20 years). Data credit: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics; not affiliated with or endorsed by BLS. Up to 1 hour old. Bad input is refused before payment, not charged. If no requested series returns data, the request is refused and not charged; if at least one series returns data, the full price is charged. USDC on Base only.
